three-partners.name: One color, three partners
structure: Hook (0-2s): the hero color and a promise, e.g. 'Burgundy, three ways.'
Partner 1 (left model): 'With ivory, it's elegant.' plus one-line reason
Partner 2 (center model): 'With red, it's striking.' plus one-line reason
Partner 3 (right model): 'With navy, it's quiet.' plus one-line reason
Close: 'Same sweater. Every piece is linked.' then the short link
rules: The hero piece is the same real product in all three looks
Each partner is its own look on the site; the video links to a series page holding all three
Partners must differ in mood (e.g. soft, bold, quiet)

color-swap.name: The color swap
structure: Model A in color X top / color Y bottom; Model C reversed
Close: numbered pieces and the short link
rules: High-contrast pairings perform best (rust and navy, red and black, pink and grey)

two-tiers.name: Heirloom vs Everyday
structure: Model A wears the Heirloom tier, Model C the Everyday tier
One line on what you gain with each
Close: numbered pieces and the short link
rules: Both tiers must match closely in color and silhouette

video_file_fields.looks: look slugs shown, in left-to-right order
video_file_fields.hook: on-screen text for the first 2 seconds
video_file_fields.caption: post caption, ending with the label line and short link
video_file_fields.hashtags: 5 to 8, mixing broad and search terms
video_file_fields.image_prompts: one per model, built from brand.md's template
video_file_fields.notes: scouting compromises and anything the reviewer should know
video_file_fields.qa: filled in by the quality check: pass/fail per image
video_file_fields.labels: two strings shown above the people, left then right

cast.people: Two in every image: T (tall AI model, 5'9") on the left and R (Rogenie, 4'6") on the right, each wearing one tier of the same look.
cast.tiers: Alternate by video: odd videos T=heirloom/R=everyday, even videos T=everyday/R=heirloom, so viewers see both tiers on both heights.
cast.labels: Show height and tier above each person, e.g. "5'9\" · Heirloom" and "4'6\" · Everyday".
